evidence: Matches the 'Wallet' label and alters wallet coin locking and database record deletion logic.
rationale: Fixes a bug where upgrading a temporary coin lock to a persistent one leaves a stale database record after spending and restart. As noted in issue #36304, 'upgrading an existing non-persistent lock to a persistent lock used emplace() without updating the existing value', causing UnlockCoin() to skip removing the record.
